main_text.l: furum[?] facile confido, nec multa præfari
ab ipsa prece exponenda exordiar, sed
prius de precis causa nonnihil mihi di-
secula tam in oriente quàm in occidente
in eo contigerunt, enarravi; nunc fert
nes tam Græcas quam Latinas inquirere,
non instituo; id existimo hac in causa,
inutile, his enim argumentis cedat uni-
det omnino necesse est, hujusmodi est
totius operis ordo & ratiocinatio, in lu-
nulli è codicibus mille annorum & non-

page.notes: Line 1 begins mid-word; the page is a fragment and "furum" is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. Long s is written as plain s throughout, including "secula" (printed as f-like form). Printed u/v spellings normalised (qv to qu, uu/vn forms). Final -que written as q; per the abbreviation rule (printed as qve/qvæ ligature). Final word "gento-" is a line-end hyphen at the page foot, continued on the next page. The grey band at the right edge is not transcribed.
